name: Metamagic Rod, Piercing
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser piercing metamagic rod 3,000 gp
Piercing metamagic rod 11,000 gp
Greater piercing metamagic rod 24,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that overcome the spell resistance of a target as though use the Piercing Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Piercing Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser piercing metamagic rod 1,500 gp
Piercing metamagic rod 5,500 gp
Greater piercing metamagic rod 12,250 gp
